name: ConicGradient
brief: A class representing the conic gradient fill of the Shape object.
description: The gradient color transitions by the angle measured around a center point, completing a full clockwise turn from the start angle.
notes: FillSpread options are ignored because the gradient always sweeps a full turn.
warnings: This class is not designed for inheritance.

members.name: conic
members.signature: Result conic(float cx, float cy, float angle = 0.0f) noexcept
description: The gradient sweeps a full turn clockwise around the center (`cx`, `cy`), beginning at `angle`. Color stop offsets from 0% to 100% map clockwise over one full turn from `angle`.

params.name: cx
params.description: The horizontal coordinate of the center of the gradient.

params.name: cy
params.description: The vertical coordinate of the center of the gradient.

params.name: angle
params.description: The initial angle in degrees, measured clockwise from the 3 o'clock direction (positive x-axis). The default is 0.0f.

members.name: conic
members.signature: Result conic(float* cx, float* cy, float* angle = nullptr) const noexcept
